charts.title: HD 118203 b: orbits around Liesma
charts.description: The orbits of Liesma's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 118203 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Castro-González et al. 2024 (2024A&A...684A.160C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname CASTRO_GONZALEZ_ET_AL_2024): P 6.1349847 d

charts.title: HD 118203 b: its transit
charts.description: HD 118203 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (22, 49, 76) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 286923464, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 23-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 23-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
